in_marathi.name: Nilima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nilima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nilima is derived from the Sanskrit word nila, meaning blue, and the word lima, meaning lotus. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower is a symbol of purity, detachment, and enlightenment. Nilima represents the pure and enlightened soul, rising above the material world.
